title: Apostles' Tombs: Uncovering the Truths and Myths #shorts

Pilgrimage sites and relics were HUGE business in the medieval period. It's like Graceland... everyone wanted a piece of that juicy tourism pie. So if they didn't have (or could steal) a real relic, then you just made one up. Not like anyone could fact check them after all.
